screen_rule.positions: source clip0/mid/end plus bound33 training/evaluation window0/16/32; unique source-frame targets
screen_rule.candidate_rule: dHash<=8 OR pHash<=8 for any cross-split frame pair
screen_rule.confirmed_requires: at least2 non-low-texture, distinct time-position matches from each clip; never decide from all-black/low-texture alone
screen_rule.scope: automatic data integrity only; no model scores, no manual test viewing
limitations: Three thumbnails can miss offset/short-overlap/cropped/reframed/reordered or semantically duplicated clips.
No candidate is not proof of exhaustive visual independence.
No automatic reassignment of historical source splits.

clip_selection: Protocol fixed first3 sourceIDs before scores, never selected from appearances or quality.
